text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: H-Hold ooon, siiiir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san! You've gone and caused trouble again, haven't you?!
Today is the day you face—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...*achoo*. ...Mm?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Feeling slightly under the weather.
The chills are getting worse too..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Today's patrol is canceled.
I ought to turn in early.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Teeth brushed—sparkling clean, complete...
Windows, doors—locked, complete...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...*achoo*.
With Bubble-san away on an away match, the place feels so big.
(Ding-dong... ding-dong...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-What is that noise!?
(Ding-dong... ding-dong...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A suspicious sound source is—
approaching this location?!
Daaaryaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Boa noite~! ...Wait, Mame-chin?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, this isn't Brazil either~?
Another failure, man.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
G-Golshi-san?! Why are you here?!
Aren't you supposed to be at the Ritto dorms?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mm. Secret tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A secret tunnel!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
G-G... Grievous offenses, these are!?
"The crime of making an unauthorized path," and "the crime of digging up the grounds without permission"--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Kh... *cough*, *cough cough*.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...! My body's craving it, I can't take it anymore!
The rhythm of the samba... the sweat, the heat!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Awe— Mametin!!
Instead, let's set our souls ablaze!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wh-What in the world does this mean!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up! On guard, Mame-chin!
With the heat from both of us, we'll create an updraft!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Roasted Carrot Speed-Eating Contest—fight!!
(Munch, munch...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Sour?! Dusty?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight!
Tunnel construction is brutal work!
I recover my energy with pickled plum power!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Phew, huff...
Th-That tasted awful, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You FINALLY finished eating!
Golshi-chan got so bored she came up with a brand-new samba dance!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do a recital later, so let me know what you think—
(Oooo--! Oooo--!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!?
That siren—is it time for construction to resume!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Mame-chin!
I gotta get back to reinforcing the tunnel~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
...Good grief, what a noisy person."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...! ...The pain in my throat, is it easing up?

One day. While walking down a quiet, tree-lined path
toward the Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Heeeey!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Halt, Golshi-san!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Don't think you can stop me
and my samba-trained footwork!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If it's that big a deal to ya...
try giving me a warning in Portuguese!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I'm waaaaitiiing for youuuu!!
choice_data_list: That's some energetic Japanese, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Boss! Good morning!
This officer is in peak health today as well!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...No. Although, just for today,
it might be thanks to the secret tunnel and the carrots, but...
choice_data_list: Keep up the good work on your patrol!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank you for all your hard work today too, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall be taking my leave...
HEY, YOU TOOOO?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
......No.
It's nothing, Boss. Pay it no mind, sir.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I've decided not to pursue the matter.
...Just this once.
